## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/types` 删掉 `field-types.ts` 里两个早已标 `@deprecated` 的孤儿类型 `VisibilityCondition` 与 `GeolocationFieldMetadata`,根入口的 "Field Types" 列表同步去掉;这是 #25921 的第 13 批。
- 为什么改:两者在 objectui#12242 之后就没有任何读者(前者给已退役的 `visible_on` 键定型,后者已被移出 `FieldMetadata` 联合,`geolocation` 不是规格字段类型);两个仓库里 0 引用,含散文。
- 风险与回滚:只删类型,构建出的 JavaScript 不变;外部 npm 宿主若 import 了它们会编译失败(未实测,changeset 写了 BREAKING 与替代写法)。`!` patch。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/types/src/field-types.ts`(两处退役注释与联合注释)、`ui/packages/types/src/index.ts`(列表)、`.changeset/25921-types-field-types-orphans.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`,预期两名都 `verified ... (export, ui/packages/types/src/field-types.ts)`、退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Batch 13 as named in the seat's amendment 6714801527 on claim 6714769871 (census option A, `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/25921-b13-census.md`, `origin/main` `7c523aa1`, hotcrm `6961ab1`).

- **`ui/packages/types/src/field-types.ts`**: `VisibilityCondition` and `GeolocationFieldMetadata` are deleted, each replaced by a short retirement comment that names the live replacement (`BaseFieldMetadata.visibleWhen`; the spec's `location` type, `LocationFieldMetadata`). The `FieldMetadata` union's comment no longer names the retired interface.
- **`ui/packages/types/src/index.ts`**: both names leave the "Field Types" export-type list, with a one-line note pointing at `field-types.ts`.
- **`__tests__/field-metadata-family-retired-12242.test.ts`**: one JSDoc prose bullet reworded so it does not name the retired interface as current. No assertion read either name.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25921-types-field-types-orphans.md`: `!` patch, BREAKING, FROM/TO for each name, `runtime-export-retired` ×2 (FROM spans 1:1), both declaration lines.

Every other name of the module stays: each has an outside reader, or is a member of `FieldMetadata` (os_out 56) and so is reached by a kept export's signature.

## Tests

- Census per name (`git grep -lw` on `origin/main`, CHANGELOGs excluded): `VisibilityCondition` hits only `field-types.ts` and `index.ts`; `GeolocationFieldMetadata` hits those plus one JSDoc line in the 12242 pin. hotcrm 0 for both. Positive controls in the same module: `FieldMetadata` 56 outside files, `BaseFieldMetadata` 11. No zod twin, not a subpath, README 0, pending changesets 0, predicate-2 surface (`*.zod.ts`, spec contracts, object definitions) 0.
- No test was added or removed, and there is no ablation: this deletes two TypeScript-only declarations and changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Left on the card (seat amendment 6714801527): option B (`FieldValidationFunction`, plus the unbarrelled `FieldConstraints` that reads it) has three prose readers in `ui/scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, outside this batch's surface; option C (`UploadedFileMetadata`) is named by the latest fields release note as the host-stored value shape. The seven `Spec*` aliases still wait on the predicate-2 ruling.
- `dist/index.js` keeps the `index.ts` retirement note as a comment line (the bundler keeps comments); no export of either name is in `dist/`.
